description: Standalone Voice settings window (Symon parity) opened from the dock (double-tap). Renders /voice-settings (the VoiceTab) independent of the main app, so voice settings + dictation history are reachable when the dock is all that's running. Needs a capability whose remote.urls matches the frontend origin AND whose windows includes 'voice-settings', or Tauri injects no __TAURI_INTERNALS__ and the settings can't read/write prefs.
